title: Illumina COVIDSeq Test: Anneal RNA
author: Opentrons
materials: Explanation of complex parameters below: * `P20 Multichannel GEN2 Pipette Mount`: Choose the mount position of your P20 Multichannel pipette, either left or right. * `Reservoir Labware Type`: Choose the type of reservoir that will be used for holding the master mix. **Note: Only the Bio-Rad Hard-Shell 96 Well Plate 200 µL plate will resume after Plate 1 and prompt for a refill of the master mix.** * `Plate 1 Columns`: Choose which columns master mix should be added on plate
Drop tips into Opentrons Fixed Trash Bin

steps.title: Pick up filter tips
steps.instruction: Pick up a fresh 20 µL filter tip from the Opentrons 96 Filter Tip Rack on Slot 10.

steps.title: Aliquot master mix to Plate 1
steps.instruction: Transfer master mix from the reservoir to Plate 1 (Slot 11) columns 1 and 2, returning residual volume to the reservoir.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate 20.0 µL from Column 1 (A1) of the Master Mix Reservoir.
Dispense 8.5 µL into Column 1 (A1) of Plate 1 on Slot 11.
Dispense 8.5 µL into Column 2 (A2) of Plate 1 on Slot 11.
Dispense the remaining 3.0 µL back into Column 1 of the Master Mix Reservoir.

steps.title: Aliquot master mix to Plate 2
steps.instruction: Transfer master mix from the reservoir to Plate 2 (Slot 8) columns 1 and 2, returning residual volume to the reservoir.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate 20.0 µL from Column 1 (A1) of the Master Mix Reservoir.
Dispense 8.5 µL into Column 1 (A1) of Plate 2 on Slot 8.
Dispense 8.5 µL into Column 2 (A2) of Plate 2 on Slot 8.
Dispense the remaining 3.0 µL back into Column 1 of the Master Mix Reservoir.

steps.title: Discard used tips
steps.instruction: Drop the used tips into the Opentrons Fixed Trash Bin.
